name: InSight Mars Lander
summary: InSight studied the interior structure of Mars by measuring seismic tremors.
hook: I placed a seismometer on the Martian plains to record marsquakes and map the planet interior.
how_it_worked: Stationary geophysical lander carrying an ultra-sensitive seismometer protected by a wind and thermal shield.
science: Recorded over 1,300 marsquakes, revealing the thickness of Mars crust and the size of its liquid core.

facts.text: InSight recorded a magnitude 5 marsquake in May 2022, the strongest ever detected on another planet.
Dust accumulation on its solar panels steadily reduced power until transmission ceased in late 2022.
